name: windy-plugin-flight-route-analyzer
description: Windy route planner using navdata uploaded and converted on GitHub; no file upload in Windy

scripts.typecheck:core: tsc --noEmit --target es2022 --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler --lib es2022,dom --strict src/navdb.ts src/weather.ts src/xplane.ts
scripts.test: tsc --target es2022 --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler --lib es2022,dom --outDir tests/generated src/navdb.ts src/xplane.ts && node tests/test.mjs && node tests/test_xplane.mjs

author: Prototype
